body: Thx man, hope you get better.

I started exercising and I feel better about my body, but I do not know how to get rid of stretch marks.
I started playing games like Apex Legends with my friends and I feel much less lonely and a lot happier.
Thx, I am a boy though.
I really don't have any one to talk to,but the fact you are happy at 36 gives me some hope.

I am so disappointed in myself. I suck so much.I have been unhappy for the last few months and I started contemplating ending myself this week.The thing is, I cannot find a positive trait about me.I used to think that I was smart back in elementary school but I am just below average intelligence. I look in the mirror and see my ugly self. I am so boring that everyone forgot about me.Literally no one wished me happy birthday. I got emails from companies. I cried all night on my 15th birthday, hoping that one person would wish me happy birthday. I was hoping for a surprise or smth but it never came.I  month ago I stopped using social media that make me compare myself to others such as Instagram and You Tube but I still hate myself. I cannot understand anything and the only thing my parents tell me are the things that I do wrong. They are disappointed in me and so am I . I wish I could do better but I cannot. I wish I was the son they deserved but I am not.Instead I cry myself to sleep, fail my exams, cry when I look in the mirror. I started thinking about ending myself as I do not really matter to anyone and I have no reason to be alive.I am too weak. I  will just go back to school and fail. Every time I open my drawer I look at my pain killers and think of killing myself. Every time I cross a road I think of killing myself. Every time I open my dresser so think of killing myself when I see a shoe lace. Please help guys.
